policy.namedCoverage: The reader uses localityOriginal and publisherRegionOriginal as published names, never coordinates or GADM, to select a governorate or a region fallback. Archived point fields remain unchanged.
policy.uncertaintyMeters: Publisher-reported positive uncertainty at most 1000 m; not independently verified accuracy.
policy.qualityScope: Checks use the geographic issues, information_withheld, data_generalizations and point policy retained in the audited research snapshot. Publisher pages are not re-fetched or re-certified by this compiler.
policy.geometry: Must fall inside the existing generalized Saudi polygons and its existing assigned region when present. Boundary-near valid records may conservatively remain text-only.
policy.administrativeNames: governorateOriginal and governorateId retain GBIF/GADM level2 assignment. governorateDerived is explicit; no city or modern official status is inferred.
policy.binding: UUID, scientific identity and baseVersion must match. The referenced verified record must retain all bound location/source fields and occurrence URLs.
policy.license: Individual occurrence license retained verbatim, separately from any dataset-level license.
policy.nonPoints: Textual source details remain available; coordinates are null when pointEligible is false.
policy.privacy: No observer names, emails, publisher identifiers, or private enrichment fields are exported.
